rationale: The workflow already satisfies the P-LIT-GHA-CACHE dependency-cache pattern for its Go jobs: both test_go and test_templates use actions/setup-go with cache-dependency-path: ./v2/go.sum, which automatically caches the Go module download cache keyed on the lockfile. The pattern's own contraindication is "An equivalent cache already exists," so adding a separate actions/cache step for Go would be redundant. The only uncached dependency step is npm install in test_js, but the lockfile for v2/internal/frontend/runtime is not present in the provided repository files, so the cache-key input prerequisite (lockfile + environment) cannot be verified; keying a cache on a missing or unchecked lockfile risks stale cache hits. P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT cannot be safely applied because ci_history contains only failed runs, leaving no representative successful-duration history from which to set a timeout with headroom. P-LIT-FAIL-FAST is already the default (true) for the matrix strategies. No supported, verifiable optimization remains that preserves existing build and test coverage.
